focus_areas: Silhouette edge continuity against bright background
Distinction between optical blur and AI artifacts
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify that the cephalofoil width is proportional to the body length (approx. 25-30%). Ensure the dorsal fin connects cleanly to the body without melting. Confirm the tail has a distinct lower lobe. Critically assess if the blur is consistent with underwater photography or indicative of AI generation.
image_description: An underwater silhouette of a hammerhead shark viewed from below against bright surface light. The distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil is clearly defined, along with the dorsal and pectoral fins. Small fish are visible in the background near the sun glare.
